description: The top field problems of a Motion Vitals project (slow frames from production, keyframer.dev/app/vitals), most frames lost first, in the dashboard's words: where each is (call site and screen), how many frames it drops while it runs against its screen's baseline, the devices and OS where it is worst, the causes of its slow frames, its status (New, Came back, Worse, Ongoing, Resolving, Fixed, Ignored), the check command and the dashboard's agent prompt. Then check with field: "<id>" measures it here. Needs KEYFRAMER_VITALS_READ_KEY: a workspace read key (kfw_) or a kf_ API key.

limit.description: How many problems, with their details. Default 5, at most 20.

project.description: The project: its code (SHOP, as in SHOP-12) or its id.

status.description: Default unresolved (new, came back, worse and ongoing); regressed is Came back; all for every status.

version.description: Only this app version. Default: every version over the last 30 days.

name: field_problems
